stories.title: Cadu de Lula defende obras viárias para integrar regiões e ampliar turismo no RN

en.title: Cadu de Lula defends road works to integrate regions and expand tourism in RN
en.summary: The PT candidate for governor of Rio Grande do Norte held a campaign rally in Natal's North Zone, advocating for road infrastructure investments to integrate regions and boost tourism development.

stories.title: Após 2 dias, Polícia Civil ainda aguarda imagens de câmeras de PMs que mataram jovem com 27 tiros

en.title: After 2 days, Civil Police still awaits body camera footage from officers who shot young man 27 times
en.summary: Over 60 hours after a youth was killed by military police in São Paulo, civil police had not yet received body camera footage from the officers involved in the incident.

stories.title: Morre RJ Mitte, ator de ‘Breaking Bad’, aos 34 anos

en.title: RJ Mitte, actor from 'Breaking Bad', dies at 34
en.summary: The actor who played Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad died at age 34. He was also known for advocating for the rights of people with disabilities.

stories.title: Selma Blair é presa após morder comissária de bordo em voo

en.title: Selma Blair arrested after biting flight attendant on flight
en.summary: Actress Selma Blair was arrested following an alleged assault on two flight attendants during a Delta Airlines flight from Los Angeles to New York, reportedly punching and biting one of them.

stories.title: Morre o ator RJ Mitte, que fez Walter White Jr. em 'Breaking Bad', aos 34 anos

en.title: Actor RJ Mitte, who played Walter White Jr. in 'Breaking Bad', dies at 34
en.summary: RJ Mitte, known for his role as Walter White Jr. in the television series Breaking Bad, has died at age 34. His representative confirmed the information to American magazine Variety.

stories.title: SBT admite erro ao atribuir à EBC falha em propaganda eleitoral

en.title: SBT admits error in attributing electoral advertising failure to EBC
en.summary: SBT acknowledged issuing incorrect information by blaming Brazil's state media company EBC for an audio failure during presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign advertisement. The broadcaster stated the technical issue occurred during program conversion.

stories.title: Governo dos EUA faz operação em casa de deputada democrata muçulmana crítica de Trump

en.title: U.S. Government conducts operation at home of Muslim Democratic congresswoman critical of Trump
en.summary: U.S. authorities conducted a search operation at the residence of Democratic Representative Ilhan Omar from Minnesota early Monday. Omar, a vocal Trump critic, has been a frequent target of attacks by the president.

stories.title: Propaganda eleitoral de Flávio na TV é transmitida sem som e TSE determina reexibição

en.title: Flávio's campaign advertisement broadcast without audio on TV; TSE orders rebroadcasting
en.summary: A television broadcast of presidential candidate Flávio's campaign advertisement was transmitted without sound. Brazil's Electoral Court has ordered the advertisement to be rebroadcasted.

stories.title: Morre RJ Mitte, ator que fez Walter White Jr. filho do protagonista em Breaking Bad

en.title: RJ Mitte, actor who played Walter White Jr. in Breaking Bad, dies
en.summary: RJ Mitte, known for playing Walter White Jr. in the series Breaking Bad, died on Monday at age 34. The cause of death was not officially confirmed.

stories.title: EBC nega participação em falha de áudio na propaganda eleitoral de Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: EBC denies involvement in audio failure during Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral campaign broadcast
en.summary: The Brazilian Communications Company (EBC) denied responsibility for a technical failure that occurred during the electoral campaign broadcast of PL candidate Flávio Bolsonaro for the presidency.

stories.title: Atriz Selma Blair é presa após confusão em voo nos EUA

en.title: Actress Selma Blair arrested following disturbance on U.S. flight
en.summary: American actress Selma Blair was arrested following a reported conflict aboard a flight between Los Angeles and New York that resulted in two flight attendants being injured, authorities said Monday.

stories.title: SBT pede desculpa por acusar EBC de falha em propaganda eleitoral de Flávio

en.title: SBT apologizes for blaming EBC for failure in Flávio Bolsonaro's electoral campaign broadcast
en.summary: SBT issued an apology after initially blaming EBC for a transmission failure affecting PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign program. SBT later acknowledged it had provided incorrect information.

stories.title: Chuva no interior de São Paulo provoca estragos em nove cidades

en.title: Heavy rain in São Paulo interior causes damage in nine cities
en.summary: Heavy rainfall in São Paulo state on Sunday caused shipwrecks, flooding, landslides and numerous fallen trees across at least nine municipalities. Seven men were rescued from the Paraná river after two vessels capsized in Presidente Epitácio due to strong winds.

stories.title: Quaest: No DF, Celina Leão tem 53% e Leandro Grass, 33%, no segundo turno

en.title: Quaest: In the Federal District, Celina Leão has 53% and Leandro Grass, 33%, in runoff
en.summary: Governor Celina Leão leads with 53% support against Leandro Grass's 33% in a runoff election for the Federal District, according to a Quaest poll. The survey shows 88% of respondents have already decided their vote ahead of the October 25 runoff.

stories.title: Bolsas de NY têm direções opostas; ‘techs’ caem e setor de energia sobe

en.title: NY exchanges move in opposite directions; tech stocks fall and energy sector rises
en.summary: US stock indices moved in different directions amid lower trading volume on Columbus Day and light economic calendar. Rising oil prices driven by Middle East tensions boosted energy stocks, while technology sector weakness pressured markets as investors await earnings season.

stories.title: Nobel premia estudos sobre efeitos das expectativas no consumo, inflação e juros, diz professor da PUC-Rio

en.title: Nobel awards studies on effects of expectations on consumption, inflation and interest rates, says PUC-Rio professor
en.summary: Michael Woodford and Robert Hall won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics for research on how expectations influence economic fluctuations and monetary policy. Their work has shaped modern central bank communication strategies and economic modeling.

stories.title: Petróleo fecha em alta e supera US$ 106 com tensões no Oriente Médio

en.title: Oil closes higher and exceeds $106 amid Middle East tensions
en.summary: Oil prices rose to two-week highs on Monday following fresh Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia over the weekend. Statements from US President Donald Trump about Ukraine and Russia agreeing to cease energy infrastructure attacks helped moderate the crude oil's upward movement.
